faq1q: How do I reset my password?
faq1a: On the login screen tap "Forgot password?", enter your username or email and open the link we email you. If you signed up with a phone number, log in with an SMS code instead.
faq2q: How do I make my account private?
faq2a: Go to Settings and activity → Account privacy and turn on Private account. Only followers you approve will see your posts and stories.
faq3q: How do I switch between accounts?
faq3a: Tap your username at the top of your profile to open the account switcher, or choose Add account in Settings.
faq4q: How do I stop someone from contacting me?
faq4a: Open their profile, tap ⋯ and choose Block, Restrict or Mute. You can manage these lists any time in Settings.
faq5q: How do I delete my account?
faq5a: Go to Accounts Center → Personal details → Delete account. Deleting is permanent.
privacyCenterDesc: Learn how Nexora handles your information and manage your privacy controls in one place.
policyText:
Nexora collects the information you provide (name, username, email or phone number, profile photo, posts, comments and messages) to operate the service.
Your login is handled by Google Firebase Authentication. Media is stored on Vercel Blob storage and data in a Neon PostgreSQL database.
We do not sell your personal data and do not show third-party ads.
Private accounts are only visible to approved followers. Blocked accounts cannot see your content.
You can permanently delete your account and all of its content at any time from Accounts Center.
Contact: ahmedbecetti35@gmail.com
termsText:
By using Nexora you agree to share only content you have the right to share and to respect other people.
Do not post nudity, violence, hate speech, harassment, spam or illegal content. Reported content may be removed and accounts that break these rules may be suspended.
You keep ownership of your content and give Nexora permission to host and display it to the audience you choose.
The service is provided as-is. We may update these terms; continued use means you accept the changes.
